svg.title: Figure 11 · Coupling makes fine-minus-coarse corrections inexpensive
svg.desc: 50,000 independent coupled paths per level; seed 1011. Coarse Brownian increments are sums of adjacent fine increments. The independent comparison is Var(fine) + Var(coarse). These Euler levels illustrate MLMC mechanics; exact terminal GBM sampling is preferable for this European benchmark.
